prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop GeoAIDesk Korean research-workspace UI design mockup, 1536 by 1024 landscape, crisp readable Korean text. This is one state in a source-first paper-to-skill coauthoring journey, not a product implementation or scientific experiment. Preserve the attached actual GAID screenshot's white/slate/blue #1f5eff institutional identity, neutral shadcn new-york controls, Lucide-like thin icons and Pretendard-like Korean sans; do NOT preserve its crowded panes, tiny fonts, colored workflow list or sample content. Do NOT copy NotebookLM visual design, branding or chat-centric layout. Build an original calm document workbench using a slim 164px left global nav, a simple top breadcrumb, generous main content, legible 18px body-scale typography, clear hierarchy and restrained blue emphasis. Global nav: GeoAIDesk logo/title, 내 연구, 연구 방법 (active), 자료, 연구노트, settings at bottom. Top right a small quiet "시각 시안" badge; no fake user identity or email. Main header "자료에서 연구 방법 만들기". Under header a horizontal three-step navigation: "자료 읽기", "방법 다듬기", "시험하기", subtle active underline, never fake success checkmarks. Source files are compact horizontal tabs above the workspace, not a permanent third sidebar. Main task dominates, no KPI counters, no hashes, agent rosters, tokens, chat log, invented results, metrics, progress percentages, or graph editor. Avoid repeated warning boxes, excessive instructional prose, decorative hero art. This researcher is starting WITHOUT an existing PU skill. Only the provided paper and materials can yield a new draft. Actual PDF imagery belongs inside a recognizable PDF viewer with page/zoom toolbar and gray document surround, never as a detached representative figure or poster. Short required Korean strings must be accurate.
STATE 1: PDF successfully received, analysis is currently reading, no extracted method yet. Active step "자료 읽기". Beneath the steps, a compact URL input containing "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11053-026-10778-w", adjacent button "자료 추가", and a secondary "파일 올리기" control. File tabs: active PDF icon "main_clean.pdf", then plus "코드·자료 추가". Main area: left 68% is the original manuscript PDF viewer using the attached real FIRST PAGE image. Toolbar: "저자 원고", "1 / 36", zoom minus/100%/plus, expand icon. Preserve the paper's English title and academic page appearance as in the reference; no map hero. Right 32% is an airy task context column with heading "자료를 읽고 있습니다", a small spinner, one sentence "연구 목적과 방법, 필요한 자료를 확인합니다." Below a modest "만들고 싶은 작업" editable field containing the illustrative researcher intent "다른 자료에 적용할 탐사 방법 만들기", small "수정" link. Beneath show a quiet neutral pending line "분석 내용이 준비되면 여기서 확인합니다." Do not populate summary cards, paper parameters, methods, completed findings or a ready-made skill. Do not show '방법 생성' enabled before analysis. Give the PDF the strongest visual focus. This frame must clearly show ordinary PDF/URL intake and a real document before findings exist.
